definitions.explanation: The shape and arrangement of the eyes, nose and mouth as a whole: how well-formed a face is. Usually with an adjective of praise, such as はっきりした (clear-cut) or {整|ととの}った (regular).

examples.japanese: {目鼻立|めはなだ}ち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{整|ととの}っている→整う：03935_totonou⟧。
{目鼻立|めはなだ}ち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦はっきりした→はっきりする：26886_hakkirisuru⟧⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧だ。
examples.english: He's a child with well-defined features.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{目鼻立|めはなだ}ち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{父親|ちちおや}→父親：03469_chichioya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{似|に}ている→似る：01159_niru⟧。
examples.english: The baby's features look a lot like the father's.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {目鼻立|めはなだ}ち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{整|ととの}っている→整う：03935_totonou⟧: to have regular, good-looking features
- {目鼻立|めはなだ}ち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦はっきりしている→はっきりする：26886_hakkirisuru⟧: to have clear-cut, well-defined features
- {目鼻立|めはなだ}ち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a good-looking person

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{顔立|かおだ}ち→顔立ち：14687_kaodachi⟧: facial features — the whole face including its outline; the commoner word
- {目鼻|めはな}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つく: (idiom) a plan takes shape — the same {目鼻|めはな}, used figuratively
